definition: The Book of Revelation, the last book of the New Testament. Dick paired it with Daniel as "the two apocalyptic books of the Bible", identified its beast with Rome and the Empire he believed fell in 1974, and read the old king on horseback of the Flow My Tears dream as Revelation's risen judge.
card_description: The Book of Revelation, which Dick read with Daniel as a description of the present Empire.
